FILE: app/notes/tighter-zoom.json
```json
{
  "asIs": 4000,
  "radiusSelf": 4000,
  "centerSelf": 4000,
  "emptyOrientation": 2000
}
```

I wrote the inferred values to `app/notes/tighter-zoom.json`, assuming that mutating `limits.radiusMax` alone does not retroactively clamp and that `setGeospatialOrientation(camera, {})` re-applies the current orientation through the library’s clamp path. I was not sure whether `radius`/`center` are implemented as clamping accessors, since the `.d.ts` files do not reveal that runtime behavior.
